name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: Commit containing refreshed investor data
        required: true
        type: string
      validation_group:
        description: Legacy code epoch accepted for compatibility; etf-publication-954 reserves the historical recovery queue
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      producer_receipt_declared:
        description: Internal caller already uploaded the exact producer expectation receipt
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  deployments: read

concurrency:
  # Producers and master pushes share one full validation queue. The selector
  # coalesces queued requests; the publisher adopts the latest safe data prefix.
  # One group per data SHA otherwise starts 8 browser jobs for every collector.
  # v5 isolates the gate containing the mandatory exposure-publication check
  # from queued v4 definitions that cannot certify it (#1218). Publishing still uses
  # the unchanged pages-production lock and published code/data ancestry checks.
  group: ${{ inputs.validation_group == 'etf-publication-954' && 'pages-validation-etf-publication-954' || format('pages-validation-v5-{0}', github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || 'master') }}
  # Superseded PR revisions cannot publish; keep every production validation.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
  queue: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'single' || 'max' }}

jobs:
  current-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      current: ${{ steps.head.outputs.current }}
      public_required: ${{ steps.surface.outputs.required }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.head.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Keep complete ancestry; fetch historical file bodies only when needed.
          filter: blob:none
          # This selector reads workflow metadata and five small scripts only.
          # A sparse worktree keeps the full commit graph while avoiding a
          # multi-gigabyte checkout that cannot complete within its 5-minute guard.
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows
            scripts/resolve-pages-snapshot.mjs
            scripts/classify-deploy-scope.mjs
            scripts/pages-gate-definition.mjs
            scripts/pages-gate-definition.json
            scripts/public-validation-scope.mjs
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - id: head
        env:
          PAGES_PRODUCTION: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
          PAGES_DEFINITION_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          PAGES_GATE_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/pages-gate-definition.json
        run: node scripts/resolve-pages-snapshot.mjs
      - id: surface
        env:
          PUBLIC_VALIDATION_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: node scripts/public-validation-scope.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        if: steps.head.outputs.current == 'true'
        with:
          name: validated-gate-definition
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pages-gate-definition.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 35
  # Data-only lane: when every file changed since the published commit is an
  # automation data path, the code already passed the full gate. Editorial and
  # visual browser checks then become advisory, so refreshed data is never held
  # back by an unrelated check; the build, Python and smoke checks still block.
  # Pull requests, code changes and any uncertainty keep the full gate.
  scope:
    needs: current-snapshot
    if: needs.current-snapshot.outputs.current == 'true' && needs.current-snapshot.outputs.public_required == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      data_only: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.data_only }}
      published: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.published }}
      commit_sha: ${{ needs.current-snapshot.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Keep full public validation for pull requests
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: echo "Public validation remains complete; publication classification is unnecessary for a PR."
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.current-snapshot.outputs.commit_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Record the data snapshot requested for publication
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/data_publication.py receipt --all --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/data-publication-receipt.json"
      # A nested producer publication keeps its original, narrower expectation.
      # The all-snapshot receipt is still generated locally for the code gate.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && !inputs.producer_receipt_declared
        with:
          name: data-publication-receipt
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/data-publication-receipt.json
          retention-days: 35
      - id: scope
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: node scripts/classify-deploy-scope.mjs --published-url "https://${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}.github.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}/build-info.json"

  build:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: read
      pages: write
    needs: current-snapshot
    if: needs.current-snapshot.outputs.current == 'true' && needs.current-snapshot.outputs.public_required == 'true'
    # Explicitly validate the next ubuntu-latest image before its rollout.
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    outputs:
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.snapshot.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.current-snapshot.outputs.commit_sha }}
      - name: Record the exact built snapshot
        id: snapshot
        run: echo "commit_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0

      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7.0.0

      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_ranking_sources.py'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_yahoo_terminal_monthly_quote.py'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_cross_fx_fallback.py'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_h10_fx.py'

      - run: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_invesco_characteristics.py'
      - run: node scripts/test-performance-rankings.mjs
      - run: node scripts/test-official-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-abtc-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-amundi-reit-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-nikkei-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-copper-manual-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-exact-share-annual-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-dws-income-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-qualified-return-windows.mjs && node scripts/test-wisdomtree-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-remainder-nav-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-wfns-distribution-consumers.mjs && node scripts/test-remainder-financial.mjs
      - run: node scripts/test-audit-history-quality.mjs && node scripts/test-reusable-data-contracts.mjs && node scripts/test-soxx-conventions.mjs && node scripts/test-dated-records.mjs && node scripts/test-shared-history-art.mjs
      - run: node scripts/build-tool-links.mjs && node scripts/test-tools-roadmap.mjs

    # Explicitly validate the next ubuntu-latest image before its rollout.

    concurrency:

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: Commit containing refreshed investor data
        required: true
        type: string
      validation_group:
        description: Legacy code epoch accepted for compatibility; etf-publication-954 reserves the historical recovery queue
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      producer_receipt_declared:
        description: Internal caller already uploaded the exact producer expectation receipt
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  deployments: read

concurrency:
  # Producers and master pushes share one full validation queue. The selector
  # coalesces queued requests; the publisher adopts the latest safe data prefix.
  # One group per data SHA otherwise starts 8 browser jobs for every collector.
  # v5 isolates the gate containing the mandatory exposure-publication check
  # from queued v4 definitions that cannot certify it (#1218). Publishing still uses
  # the unchanged pages-production lock and published code/data ancestry checks.
  group: ${{ inputs.validation_group == 'etf-publication-954' && 'pages-validation-etf-publication-954' || format('pages-validation-v5-{0}', github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || 'master') }}
  # Superseded PR revisions cannot publish; keep every production validation.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
  queue: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'single' || 'max' }}

  current-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 5

      public_required: ${{ steps.surface.outputs.required }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.head.outputs.commit_sha }}

          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Keep complete ancestry; fetch historical file bodies only when needed.
          filter: blob:none
          # This selector reads workflow metadata and five small scripts only.
          # A sparse worktree keeps the full commit graph while avoiding a
          # multi-gigabyte checkout that cannot complete within its 5-minute guard.

    needs: [scope, build, tweet-midi-checks, python-checks, browser-checks, exposure-browser-check, smoke]
    if: >-

    # Explicitly validate the next ubuntu-latest image before its rollout.
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04

    # or replacing a waiting 13F deployment with an unrelated/older run.
    concurrency:

      - name: Freeze the validated composite publication sealer
        run: cp scripts/data_publication.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/seal-code-data-publication.py"
      - id: data
        env:
          VALIDATED_CODE_SHA: ${{ needs.build.outputs.commit_sha }}
          REQUIRED_DATA_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/code-data-required.json
        run: node scripts/prepare-code-data-refresh.mjs
      - if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        run: npm ci
      - if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        run: npm run audit:data-catalog && npm run build
      - name: Require every primary producer file after rebuilding newer data
        if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        env:
          REQUIRED_DATA_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/code-data-required.json
        run: |
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
          import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'
          import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
          const required=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.REQUIRED_DATA_RECEIPT))
          assert(Object.keys(required).length)
          for(const [path,sha] of Object.entries(required))assert.equal(execFileSync('git',['hash-object',path],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(),sha,'A validated producer file changed during rebuild: '+path)
          JS
      - if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        run: node scripts/smoke-data-routes.mjs
      - name: Seal the rebuilt code and data identities
        if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'
        env:
          CODE_SHA: ${{ steps.data.outputs.code_sha }}
          DATA_SHA: ${{ steps.data.outputs.data_sha }}
        run: |
          python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/seal-code-data-publication.py" manifest --data-commit "${{ steps.data.outputs.data_sha }}" --output dist/data/publication-manifest.json
          node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
          import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'
          writeFileSync('dist/build-info.json',JSON.stringify({sha:process.env.CODE_SHA,dataSha:process.env.DATA_SHA,lane:'validated-code-data',builtAt:new Date().toISOString()})+'\n')

      - if: steps.data.outputs.refresh == 'true'

      - name: Skip superseded production snapshots

        env:

          PAGES_CODE_SHA: ${{ steps.data.outputs.code_sha }}
          PAGES_FALLBACK: ${{ steps.data.outputs.refresh }}

        if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5.0.1
        with:

        run: node scripts/verify-pages-publication.mjs "${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}" "${{ steps.data.outputs.code_sha }}" "${{ steps.data.outputs.data_sha }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        if: always() && steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        with:
          name: verified-publication
          path: test-artifacts/publication-verified.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 35

  # Fallback lane: the full gate failed on a snapshot whose code changed since the
  # published commit. Refreshed data must not wait for a human to repair the code:
  # rebuild the published (already validated) code with the new automation data,
  # and publish it if the build and the data smoke test pass. The failed checks
  # stay red in this run and in the monitoring issue.
  fallback-build:
    needs: [scope, build, tweet-midi-checks, python-checks, browser-checks, exposure-browser-check, smoke]
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      && needs.scope.result == 'success' && needs.scope.outputs.data_only != 'true' && needs.scope.outputs.published != ''
      && !(needs.build.result == 'success' && needs.tweet-midi-checks.result == 'success' && needs.python-checks.result == 'success' && needs.smoke.result == 'success'
           && needs.browser-checks.result == 'success' && needs.exposure-browser-check.result == 'success')
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      data_sha: ${{ steps.compose.outputs.data_sha }}
      code_sha: ${{ steps.compose.outputs.code_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.commit_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Freeze the fallback publication sealer before switching code
        run: cp scripts/data_publication.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/seal-fallback-publication.py"
      - id: compose
        run: node scripts/compose-fallback-snapshot.mjs --published "${{ needs.scope.outputs.published }}"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Seal final fallback data after all generators
        run: python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/seal-fallback-publication.py" manifest --data-commit "${{ steps.compose.outputs.data_sha }}" --output dist/data/publication-manifest.json
      - name: Record the published code and the data snapshot
        run: printf '{"sha":"%s","dataSha":"%s","lane":"fallback","builtAt":"%s"}\n' "${{ steps.compose.outputs.code_sha }}" "${{ steps.compose.outputs.data_sha }}" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > dist/build-info.json
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: chromium-ubuntu26-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: node scripts/smoke-data-routes.mjs
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v6.0.0
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5.0.0
        with:
          name: github-pages-fallback
          path: dist
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        with:
          name: fallback-publication-manifest
          path: dist/data/publication-manifest.json
          retention-days: 2

  deploy-fallback:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    needs: fallback-build
    if: always() && needs.fallback-build.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    concurrency:
      group: pages-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.fallback-build.outputs.data_sha }}
      - name: Skip superseded production snapshots
        id: current
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PAGES_CODE_SHA: ${{ needs.fallback-build.outputs.code_sha }}
          PAGES_FALLBACK: 'true'
        run: bash scripts/check-pages-head.sh
      - id: deployment
        if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5.0.1
        with:
          artifact_name: github-pages-fallback
      - if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        run: echo "Données publiées avec le dernier code validé (voie de secours). Le code de master reste à réparer." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"


      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        with:
          name: fallback-publication-manifest
          path: dist/data
      - name: Verify the actual fallback data artifact
        if: steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        run: node scripts/verify-pages-publication.mjs "${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}" "${{ needs.fallback-build.outputs.code_sha }}" "${{ needs.fallback-build.outputs.data_sha }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1
        if: always() && steps.current.outputs.current == 'true'
        with:
          name: verified-fallback-publication
          path: test-artifacts/publication-verified.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 35
